result.title: D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform
result.summary: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.

AI.brief_summary: D-DOIT 提出一种免训练的离散扩散适配方法，以 Doob h-变换重加权反向转移概率，通过采样候选状态、补全序列并用奖励 oracle 评估后再重采样，避免未来 rollout，并在 DNA 与蛋白质逆折叠基准上优于免训练引导基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「采样候选—补全—奖励评估—重采样」的逐步离散状态选择机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新、证据筛选与停止/分支决策提供方法线索；但奖励倾斜的目标与多模态推理差异较大，落地路径需核查。
